beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Course tile animations share a timer across repeated interactions, skip hidden tiles, and make fewer repaint requests.
• Activate task and Hide task now share a hover button inside the Task editor, leaving more room for text.

Fixes:
• Fixed animation timers continuing after their last tile was removed.
• Fixed animated course tiles showing outdated text or colors after their contents changed.

stable.notes:
Fixes:
• Fixed the sample verification window reporting "All fields verified" when the date box was still empty. An automatically read date was stamped on the sample and counted as checked without ever being shown, so it could be saved without anyone seeing it.
